result.brief: 提出 WorldReforge：构建 6.2 万条扰动抓取失败仿真轨迹数据集，并用交互对齐重建与表面点对应特征训练信号，提升动作条件机器人世界模型在失败场景下的物体运动预测与表征质量。
result.reason: Trains action-conditioned robot world models on simulated failure trajectories with interaction-aligned reconstruction and surface-correspondence feature learning, improving object-motion prediction.
